verdict.rationale: Granola has a dedicated model-training doc page saying users can opt out of model training in Settings at any time. It also documents HIPAA compliance for Enterprise customers. However, nothing shows the opt-out is an admin-enforced, organization-wide control rather than a per-user setting, and there is no SOC 2 evidence. Missing for 10: org-level enforceable training opt-out controlled by admins, SOC 2 attestation documentation, explicit statement of default training behavior, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture

citations.quote: You can opt out of model training in Settings.
You can opt out of model training at any time.
Granola is HIPAA compliant for Enterprise customers.
